description: This file contains TypeScript module declarations for the Microsoft Teams SDK, defining classes and types used to interact with Microsoft Teams APIs, including app configuration, client API, and JWT validation.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application, allowing retrieval of bot token and app graph token.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with Microsoft Teams API, including sending activities in conversations.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: Handles validation of JWT tokens for Microsoft Teams authentication.

methods.name: App.constructor
methods.description: Constructor for the App class, initializes with client ID, secret, and optional tenant ID.

methods.name: App.getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Retrieves the application graph token asynchronously.

methods.name: Client.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the client with service URL and optional options including token and headers.

methods.name: JwtValidator.constructor
methods.description: Constructs a JWT validator with specified options and optional logger.

methods.name: JwtValidator.validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT access token with optional service URL validation.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a token validator function for a given app ID and optional tenant ID.

methods.name: constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string }); constructor
